title: A one-of-a-kind theater experience I will never forget! #OffBroadway ...
transcript: This was one of the coolest theatrical experiences I've ever had! This production takes place in a top-secret loft in the Flatiron District. They didn't even send us the address until the day before. So you show up to the address, you check in at the door, walk down this long hallway, take an elevator up 4 floors, and then you make a right and you just see this gorgeous New York City loft! This production of Uncle Vanya is being built as hyper-intimate which means it is playing to a very small crowd. The original run ran for 16 performances back in June and July and that was playing to a crowd of 40 people. This time around it is a slightly larger space (I counted 96 seats) so it's about double the capacity, but it definitely still feels intimate. And going into it I was definitely going for more of the experience than the actual play itself. Because to be honest, I'm not a big Chekhov fan, and while I had never seen Uncle Vanya specifically, it was not a story that particularly intrigued me. It's a Russian play, so everyone's just sad and depressed and it's kind of just about how miserable everyone is. And that's not the type of place that I tend to like to see. But the fact that it was being staged in a private loft in Flatiron was really intriguing to me and then you add a group of really talented actors, and being able to see them perform up close and personal, it felt like an opportunity that I couldn't pass up. And the performances are really what carries this piece of theater. There's some really really exceptional performances here, with special notice to Will Brill and Marin Ireland as Astrov and Sonya. I thought they were fantastic, and I could not take my eyes off them anytime they were on stage. And then you have the production itself, and I think that they did a really good job staging it in this loft environment. It really did make you feel like you are a fly on the wall. There is a good chunk of this play that is entirely lit by candlelight, and I thought that was one of the coolest moments. And it really is that combination of a really intimate production combined with really great actors at the top of their game, that made this production a must see for me and I'm so glad that I went and saw it!
